answer: Reputation follows exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life, so a quill of brief activity cannot replace sustained honest service. EigenTrust matrix factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity reward durable, corroborated links. Freshly spawned sybil identities have negligible incoming trust and near-zero eigenvector centrality, leaving no credible path across the trust reef or terrace of consensus thresholds; they cannot pass consensus until trustworthy history accumulates.
